A particle has position s(t)=t³−4.7t²+2.1t+6 meters. What is its velocity at t=2.35 seconds, to the nearest hundredth?

A. −5.34 m/s
B. −3.81 m/s
C. −3.42 m/s
D. 2.35 m/s
